create_PCA_projection: create a PCA model to project Iris data onto 2 principal components for maximum variance
create_LDA_projection: create a LinearDiscriminantAnalysis model to project Iris data onto components separating classes
load_iris_dataset: load the Iris dataset with 4 features and 3 class labels for classification and visualization
plot_PCA_scatter: plot a 2D scatter of Iris samples colored by class on the first two PCA components
plot_LDA_scatter: plot a 2D scatter of Iris samples colored by class on the first two LDA components
